description: Source code for the PHPMailer class, which provides functionalities for creating, validating, and sending emails via different transport mechanisms (mail, SMTP, sendmail, qmail). It includes constants, properties, and methods for email composing, address management, validation, and transmission.

classes.name: PHPMailer
classes.description: Main class for creating, validating, and sending emails using various transport mechanisms.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PHPMailer object, optionally setting whether exceptions should be thrown, and sets debug output format.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Prepares and sends the email message, handling exceptions if configured.

methods.name: preSend
methods.description: Performs validation, MIME message construction, and header preparation before sending.

methods.name: postSend
methods.description: Dispatches the email via the selected transport method.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Adds a recipient email address to the 'to' list.

methods.name: addCC
methods.description: Adds a recipient email address to the 'cc' list.

methods.name: addBCC
methods.description: Adds a recipient email address to the 'bcc' list.

methods.name: addReplyTo
methods.description: Adds a reply-to address.

methods.name: setFrom
methods.description: Sets the sender's email address and name, with optional automatic setting of the envelope sender.

methods.name: mailSend
methods.description: Uses PHP's mail() function to send an email, constructing headers and managing envelope sender.

methods.name: getSMTPInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of SMTP for SMTP-based email sending, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: setSMTPInstance
methods.description: Sets a custom SMTP instance for email transmission.

methods.name: setSMTPXclientAttribute
methods.description: Configures SMTP XCLIENT attributes for proxying SMTP connections.

methods.name: getSMTPXclientAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves current SMTP XCLIENT attributes.

methods.name: smtpSend
methods.description: Handles SMTP communication to send email headers and body, managing recipients, handshake, and error handling.

methods.name: smtpConnect
methods.description: Establishes SMTP connection with server, supporting multiple hosts, SSL/TLS, and authentication.

methods.name: smtpClose
methods.description: Closes active SMTP session if one exists.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets language translations for error messages, loading language files from specified path.

methods.name: getTranslations
methods.description: Returns current language translation strings.

methods.name: addrAppend
methods.description: Creates formatted recipient headers for email (To, Cc, Bcc, Reply-To).

methods.name: addrFormat
methods.description: Formats an individual email address and name pair for headers.

methods.name: wrapText
methods.description: Word-wraps message text, supporting quoted-printable encoding and respecting multibyte characters.

methods.name: utf8CharBoundary
methods.description: Ensures multi-byte UTF-8 characters are not split when wrapping text.

methods.name: setWordWrap
methods.description: Sets message body or alternative part to wrapped lines based on WordWrap setting.

methods.name: createHeader
methods.description: Assembles message headers including from, to, subject, message ID, and custom headers.

methods.name: getMailMIME
methods.description: Returns headers for the MIME message, including content-type and boundaries.

methods.name: getSentMIMEMessage
methods.description: Returns the complete MIME message with headers and body, ready to be sent.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Creates a unique boundary ID for multipart messages.

methods.name: createBody
methods.description: Assembles MIME message body, handling various content types, multipart, encodings, and optional signing.

methods.name: getBoundaries
methods.description: Returns or generates MIME boundaries used in multipart messages.

methods.name: getBoundary
methods.description: Returns the start boundary string with headers for a MIME part.

methods.name: endBoundary
methods.description: Returns the closing boundary string for MIME multipart message.

methods.name: setMessageType
methods.description: Determines the message type based on attachments, inline content, and alternative parts.

methods.name: headerLine
methods.description: Formats a header line with name and value.

methods.name: textLine
methods.description: Forms a line in the email message or headers.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Adds a file attachment from filesystem to the email.

methods.name: getAttachments
methods.description: Returns list of attachments added to the message.

methods.name: attachAll
methods.description: Encodes and attaches all files and strings as MIME parts, managing inline and attachments.

methods.name: encodeFile
methods.description: Reads a file and encodes it in the specified encoding (base64, quoted-printable, etc.)

methods.name: encodeString
methods.description: Encodes a string into base64, quoted-printable, or binary for email transfer.

methods.name: encodeHeader
methods.description: Encodes header strings with base64 or Q-encoding, choosing shortest encoding for MIME headers.

methods.name: wrapText
methods.description: Wraps long lines of text, respecting multibyte characters and optional quoted-printable encoding.

methods.name: utf8CharBoundary
methods.description: Finds character boundary in UTF-8 strings to avoid splitting multibyte characters.

methods.name: setBoundaries
methods.description: Creates MIME boundary strings for multipart messages.
